description: WireGuard overlay addressing. This file is the single source of truth for the overlay network. Both the Master and every peer read these values; neither role hard-codes them.

reserved_peer_addresses.10.100.0.1: the Master Anchor — never assignable to a peer
reserved_peer_addresses.10.100.0.255: broadcast — never assignable to a peer

peer_allowed_ips_rule: A peer's [Peer] AllowedIPs must cover exactly one address: 10.100.0.1/32 for the Master edge, or the peer's own single /32 on a Master-side stanza. Wider masks permit source-spoofing a sibling.
mtu_rationale: Keeps the tunnel clear of the 1500-byte path MTU when the same NIC also carries RoCEv2/TCP.
teardown: Master-side revocation, or the node-local containment KillSwitch. Never a plain systemctl stop.
